in_marathi.name: Kalpitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Created by Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalpitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kalpa' which means 'Creation' or 'Age' and 'Tha' which means 'Born'. This name is believed to be given to a child born during a divine creation. In Hindu mythology, Vishnu is the preserver of the universe, and it is believed that children named Kalpitha are born with the blessings of Vishnu.
